findings.issue: «del santo» names a holy person; the token is the common noun הַקֹּדֶשׁ (holiness / the holy), with no person marked.
Plural אֲלָפִים and מֵאוֹת, and feminine שֵׁשׁ, are smoothed into the Spanish compounds ocho mil and seiscientos; the count remains eight thousand six hundred.

notes: The census phrase, the month-and-upward bound, and the participle-plus-charge cognate match the tokens.
